name: Stage 24:2: Hållsta to Kvarntorp
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 24:2, Hållsta to Kvarntorp.
utilities: Hållsta is the official start but has no parking at the stage start. Bus access is via Hållsta/Åläng area stops west of the route; official text still mentions bus 9, while current transit references and OSM point to Sörmlandstrafiken line 19, so verify live departures before using it.

Bälgviken gives mid-stage bus and possible parking/access context, but no dependable shop, cafe, food service, or active rail service was verified; treat the former railway station as bus/access context only.

Kvarntorp is the main facility endpoint, with shelter, grill/fireplace, good tent spots, bathing, and nearby reserve parking. No toilet, bin, or reliable drinking-water point was verified at Kvarntorp. A viewpoint/rest table about 350 m north of the shelter is useful for map context but not a service point.
waterSources: No official drinking-water source is listed on stage 24:2. Carry water from Hållsta/Eskilstuna or from verified services before starting.

Lake water from Bälgvikssjön/Näshultasjön and any streams/springs should be treated as natural/untested. OSM/Vindskyddskartan-style sources mention Kvarntorp-area spring/well context, but Sörmlandsleden and reserve pages do not list it as a stage water source and hiker reports describe difficulty finding or trusting water here; treat/filter/boil and carry backup.
The nearest official sources are on stage 24:3 beyond Kvarntorp, not on this stage.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official and Naturkartan distance is 14 km. OSM relation 9631288 is tagged distance=14 km and current relation geometry measures roughly 13.2 km, while local/third-party derived tracks run about 12.7-13.0 km; use official 14 km as canonical.

Draw Stage 24:2 as a standalone continuous route from Hållsta to the Kvarntorp handoff. OSM/local topology shares nodes cleanly with 24:1 at Hållsta and 24:3 at Kvarntorp; the official shelter coordinate sits about 80-90 m from the local chain node, so keep it as an endpoint facility/short spur rather than warping the stage line. Do not merge 24:1, 24:3, Lillsundet side path, Kvarntorp shelter spur, parking connectors, or Österby seasonal services into the stage geometry.

Official current fault dated 2026-04-19 reports forestry work between Ståltorp/Stålstorp and Bälgviken, with logs and branches on the trail and machine-damaged/churned tread. Expect a slower, rougher passage and follow current markings carefully.

Route character is generally easy walking: gravel road from Hållsta, Årby younger Iron Age grave field with many mounds and a standing stone, old lime-kiln/quarry remains, conifer forest and rocky sections, road 694 crossing, Bälgviken old station/railway crossing, gravel road by Bälgvikssjön, Smalsundet/Lillsundet lake-rest context, a viewpoint/table north of the Kvarntorp shelter, and Kvarntorp reserve/Näshultasjön.

Kvarntorp is a municipal nature reserve, about 217 ha and protected since 2007. Do not damage living or dead trees/shrubs, ground, stones, or bedrock; do not collect/kill invertebrates; do not damage/pick protected flora beyond permitted berries/edible mushrooms/flowers for personal use; avoid ad hoc fires on ground or rock. Use only established fireplaces and check fire-ban status.

Kvarntorp has official good tent spots and no explicit tenting ban was found in the reserve rules. Use low-impact one-night tenting near the indicated area, respect grazing animals near Kvarntorp, keep dogs under close control/leashed around livestock, and follow posted signs.

facilities.name: Hållsta / Åläng bus context
facilities.description: Closer Hållsta/Åläng-area bus access is still a road walk from the route. Official text says bus 9, while current transit references and OSM indicate line 19; verify live Sörmlandstrafiken departures.

facilities.name: Hållsta pizzeria and fuel context
facilities.description: Opening-hour-dependent Hållsta pizzeria and nearby fuel context west of the stage start. No current public kiosk/lodging claim was verified; not a trailhead service.

facilities.name: Årby grave field and lime-kiln remains
facilities.description: Approximate early-stage cultural-history context: younger Iron Age grave field with many mounds and one standing stone, plus old 19th-century limestone-kiln/quarry remains. Look but do not disturb.

facilities.description: Current official 2026-04-19 fault: forestry work between Ståltorp/Stålstorp and Bälgviken, with logs/branches on the trail and churned-up tread.

facilities.name: Stålstorp bus/forestry warning area
facilities.description: Rural bus/context point near the current forestry-warning corridor. Verify service before using as access.

facilities.description: OSM-mapped tiny free parking context near the road-694/Ulriksdal area, not listed by the official trail page and likely very limited. Use only if signed/legal and do not block local access.

facilities.name: Bälgviken station/bus context
facilities.description: Mid-stage bus/parking context at the old station area. Useful bailout/access point, but no dependable food resupply or active rail service was verified.

facilities.name: Bälgviken parking context
facilities.description: Official stage text says parking is possible in Bälgviken, but no specific mapped car park was verified; follow local signs and avoid blocking residents or bus access.

facilities.name: Road 694 crossing

facilities.name: Bälgviken railway crossing

facilities.name: Smalsundet water pause context
facilities.description: Approximate water-side pause context around Smalsundet, the hand-dug canal between Bälgvikssjön and Näshultasjön. No toilet, tap or formal service verified.

facilities.name: Lillsundet lakeside rest/fire ring
facilities.description: Signed side-path rest context north of Lillsundet with table, fire ring and jetty reported in official/secondary descriptions; approximate pin.

facilities.name: Kvarntorp reserve parking, verify locally
facilities.description: Sörmlandsleden indicates parking at/near Kvarntorps naturreservat and Eskilstuna directions describe a first parking after the Bälgviken-Kvarntorp approach, but accessibility facts conflict; do not assume accessible, abundant, or guaranteed parking.

facilities.name: Kvarntorp unverified spring context
facilities.description: OSM-mapped spring with drinking_water=yes near Kvarntorp, but not listed by Sörmlandsleden or reserve pages as a stage water source and reported hard to rely on by hikers. Treat/filter/boil and carry backup.

facilities.name: Kvarntorp reserve rules
facilities.description: Reserve rules forbid damaging trees, shrubs, ground, stones, or bedrock, including by fire, and restrict collecting/killing plants and invertebrates. Use only established fireplaces and follow posted signs.

facilities.name: Kvarntorp shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter at Kvarntorp/Boängsudden area, about 80-90 m west of the route handoff. OSM/shelter sources list around four sleeping places; condition was not recently independently verified, so plan conservatively.

facilities.name: Kvarntorp shelter fireplace
facilities.description: Official grill/fireplace context at Kvarntorp shelter. No firewood guarantee and no rubbish-bin guarantee; current fire bans override use.

facilities.name: Kvarntorp tent spots and Näshultasjön swimming
facilities.description: Official good tent spots and bathing possibility by Näshultasjön. No toilet, tap, or bin was verified; respect reserve rules, grazing animals, and posted signs.

facilities.name: Kvarntorp viewpoint and table
facilities.description: Approximate viewpoint/rest table about 350 m north of the Kvarntorp shelter, from official maintainer tip. Useful rest context but no toilet, water, bin or fire claim.

facilities.name: Näshulta / Österby bathing context
facilities.description: Off-route bathing/beach context around Näshultasjön/Österby Camping, with seasonal local facilities reported by municipality/camping sources. Not a potable-water source or guaranteed trail facility.

facilities.description: Seasonal off-route camping/cabins/kiosk/service-house context near Näshultasjön, generally May-September. Verify opening before relying on it.
